main.description: Returns the indexed evaluation at the given AT-URI with its publisher and evaluator views. Authentication is not required.

uri.description: AT-URI of the evaluation record, using a DID authority; lookup is by URI only, not a specific CID/version.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The URI is invalid or does not identify an evaluation record.

errors.name: RecordNotFound
errors.description: No indexed evaluation was found at this AT-URI.

hydratedEvaluationEvaluatorView.description: An original evaluator entry with its profile and organization sidecars looked up.

omittedEvaluationEvaluatorView.description: An original evaluator entry not hydrated.

evaluationView.description: Evaluation with the complete original record, hydrated publisher, and evaluator views. For hydrated actors, missing profile or organization sidecars are null; query or hydration failures fail the request.

evaluators.description: One-for-one projection of record.evaluators, preserving source order, duplicates, and entry fields. Entries after position 100 remain present with hydrationStatus "omitted" and no profile or organization.
